original_question: For a geometrically finite rational map f, develop an analogue of the Haken decomposition for 3-manifolds. In particular, when the Julia set J is disconnected, can f be obtained by surgery from rational maps whose Julia sets are connected?
target_in_paper: Problem 3 in the section "Geometrically finite rational maps".
correct_elements: Your draft already captures the correct target almost verbatim: it asks for an analogue of the Haken decomposition for a geometrically finite rational map f, and it preserves the paper's specific example asking whether a map with disconnected Julia set can be obtained by surgery from rational maps with connected Julia sets.
missing_details: The map should be specified as a rational map f on the Riemann sphere.
The notation J should be defined as the Julia set J(f).

The term "geometrically finite" should be defined exactly as in the paper: if C is the set of critical points and P(f)=⋃_{n≥1} f^n(C) is the post-critical set, then f is geometrically finite when P(f)∩J(f) is finite.
The paper explicitly gives the equivalent hypothesis that every critical point in J(f) is pre-periodic; this is part of the nearby context and may be used as an alternate formulation.

The paper poses the surgery question only as an example of the broader Haken-decomposition analogue; a faithful stand-alone version should preserve that structure rather than treating the disconnected-Julia-set case as the whole problem.
There is no degree restriction and no polynomial-only restriction in the paper; the problem is stated for general rational maps.
refined_question: Let f be a rational map of the Riemann sphere, with critical set C, post-critical set P(f)=⋃_{n≥1} f^n(C), and Julia set J(f). Assume f is geometrically finite, meaning that P(f)∩J(f) is finite. Develop for f an analogue of the Haken decomposition for 3-manifolds. In particular, if J(f) is disconnected, can f be constructed by surgery from rational maps whose Julia sets are connected?
equivalent_formulation: Equivalently, let f be a rational map of the Riemann sphere such that every critical point of f lying in J(f) is pre-periodic. Develop for f an analogue of the Haken decomposition for 3-manifolds; in particular, when J(f) is disconnected, can f be constructed by surgery from rational maps with connected Julia sets?
justification: The draft is targeting the paper's Problem 3 essentially word for word. To make it stand-alone and faithful to the paper, one must import the immediately preceding notation and definition: the paper defines the critical set C, the post-critical set P(f), the Julia set J(f), and the notion of geometric finiteness via finiteness of P(f)∩J(f), with the stated equivalent reformulation in terms of pre-periodic critical points in the Julia set. The phrase "For example" in Problem 3 shows that the disconnected-Julia-set surgery question is a concrete special case of the broader request for a Haken-type decomposition, so the refined version should keep both the general decomposition problem and the illustrative disconnected-case question.
